spec_match.rationale: Implements HTML's tokenize-the-features and check-if-a-popup-window-is-requested algorithms, plus the explainer's split/splitposition/splitsize parsing rules.

interactive.rationale: Free-text input, seven presets, a token table, two prediction panes, and a real window.open() check against this browser.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers odd case and spacing, invalid hints, out-of-range size, noopener, an empty string, and split+popup.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/<id> plus the spec/explainer sections it exercises.

conformance.rationale: Prediction logic is not itself in the suite. The manual fallback assertion covers the outcome.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: the bare 'split' prediction (popup) and the 'popup=0,split' prediction (tab) both matched observed toolbar.visible; no console errors; 0px overflow. the API is absent in Chromium 153 even with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features / --enable-blink-features=WindowOpenSplitTab, so only the legacy branch was observed, and headless has no split-view UI.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons override both background and color; verdict colours use emerald-dark/rose on stone; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled input, preset group with aria-label, scoped table headers, live predictions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Preset buttons wrap; table fits at 360px.

openQuestions.title: Supporting-browser prediction for split+popup is ambiguous
openQuestions.detail: When split+popup is requested and the UA declines the split, the result is a popup. The tool predicts 'tab' under supporting rules. Add an 'either' outcome once a supporting browser can be observed.

guidanceConsulted.query: form controls radio group fieldset legend accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group related radios/checkboxes in fieldset+legend and label every control.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Option groups use fieldset/legend or wrapping labels; range inputs have associated label+output.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status live region announce async result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous results via polite live regions; keep native buttons/labels; visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts/outputs are role=status or aria-live=polite; all controls are native buttons/inputs with visible text labels and a 3px focus outline; min 44px targets.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic grid tracks (minmax(min(100%, Xrem), 1fr)) and wrap long monospace strings so nothing overflows at 360px.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Card grids use minmax(min(100%,…),1fr); outputs use overflow-wrap:anywhere; measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3.

summary: A useful tool that turns the legacy-popup trap into something you can see, and it is verified against real browser behaviour.
